facts.text: This article originally appeared on Golfweek: 2026 World Wide Technology Championship tee times, how to watch final round Sunday
Sunday's final round will be live from 3-6 p.m.
Rookie Ben James is the leader by four shots entering Sunday at the Tiger Woods-designed El Cardonal at Diamante in Los Cabos, as he looks to capture the first victory of his young career.
But despite the considerable cushion, James will need to keep his foot on the gas pedal with proven winners like Ryan Gerard and Chris Kirk still in the mix, hoping to chase down the rising star.
You can watch Saturday’s third round of the 2026 World Wide Technology Championship from 3-6 p.m.
Simulcasts of the Saturday TV coverage can be viewed on Golfchannel.com and the Golf Channel app.
As a four-year member of Columbia’s inaugural class of female varsity golfers, Jessica can out-birdie everyone on the masthead.
Her origi­nal interview series, “A Round With,” debuted in November of 2015, and appeared both in the magazine and in video form on GOLF.com.
All of our market picks are independently selected and curated by the editorial team.

The 2026 PGA Tour season is winding down, and so are players’ opportunities to secure their status for 2027.
Watch the World Wide Technology Championship at El Cardonal at Diamante in Los Cabos, Mexico.
Golf Channel's first round coverage begins at 3 p.m.
ET on Thursday, followed by "Golf Channel Postgame."
The final round of the PGA Tour’s World Wide Technology Championship takes center stage on Sunday at El Cardonal in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico.
Final-round coverage begins on Golf Channel at 3 p.m.
ET on Sunday with “Golf Central Postgame” following.
